title: Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s Houthis Trade Threats to Hit Oil Facilities
summary: The Iran-backed militia threatened to attack the Saudi energy giant Aramco after the Saudi authorities issued an evacuation notice for an oil facility in the Yemeni capital.
body_markdown: The Iran-backed militia threatened to attack the Saudi energy giant Aramco after the Saudi authorities issued an evacuation notice for an oil facility in the Yemeni capital.
